4-2 The motion of Electrons in a Periodic Lattice
4-2 电子在周期性晶格中的运动

Most of the properties of semiconductors can be understood via the periodic nature of the potential experienced by the electrons in a real solid.
大多数半导体的性质可以通过电子在真实固体中所经历的周期性势能来理解。

Effects of Lattice periodicity:
晶格周期性的影响：

The wave functions are no longer sinusoidal travelling waves of constant amplitude, but exhibit the lattice periodicity in their amplitudes. Electrons may be scattered by the lattice.
波函数不再是恒定振幅的正弦传播波，而是表现出振幅的晶格周期性。电子可能会被晶格散射。

Question: How to find the allowed energies of electrons in solids?
问题：如何找到固体中电子的允许能量？

  • Modelling the periodic potential seen by an electron in the crystal lattice by a succession of rectangular wells and barriers. Solved the Schrödinger equation for such a potential
    通过一系列矩形势阱和势垒来模拟电子在晶格中看到的周期性势。为这种势解了薛定谔方程。
− ℏ 2 2 m ∇ 2 ψ + V ( r ¯ ) ψ = E ψ − ℏ 2 2 m ∇ 2 ψ + V ( r ¯ ) ψ = E ψ -(ℏ^(2))/(2m)grad^(2)psi+V( bar(r))psi=E psi-\frac{\hbar^{2}}{2 m} \nabla^{2} \psi+V(\bar{r}) \psi=E \psi
⇒ ⇒ =>\Rightarrow Two sets of solutions: the sinusoidal wave solutions in certain energy ranges (allowed bands) and real decaying exponential wave solutions in the other ranges (the forbidden bands)
⇒ ⇒ =>\Rightarrow 两组解：在某些能量范围内的正弦波解（允许带）和在其他范围内的实数衰减指数波解（禁带）

4-2-1 Bloch Theorem  4-2-1 布洛赫定理

The solutions of the Schrodinger equation in such a potential are not pure plan waves as they were in the case of a free particle, but are waves which are modulated by a function having the periodicity of the potential or lattice. Such functions are then called Bloch wavefunctions and can be expressed as
在这种势能下，薛定谔方程的解不是自由粒子情况下的纯平面波，而是由具有势能或晶格周期性的函数调制的波。这种函数被称为布洛赫波函数，可以表示为
Ψ ( k ⇀ , r ⇀ ) = exp ⁡ ( i k ⇀ ⋅ r ⇀ ) u ( k ⇀ , r ⇀ ) Ψ ( k ⇀ , r ⇀ ) = exp ⁡ ( i k ⇀ ⋅ r ⇀ ) u ( k ⇀ , r ⇀ ) Psi(k^(⇀),r^(⇀))=exp(ik^(⇀)*r^(⇀))u(k^(⇀),r^(⇀))\Psi(\stackrel{\rightharpoonup}{k}, \stackrel{\rightharpoonup}{r})=\exp (i \stackrel{\rightharpoonup}{k} \cdot \stackrel{\rightharpoonup}{r}) u(\stackrel{\rightharpoonup}{k}, \stackrel{\rightharpoonup}{r})
where k → k → vec(k)\vec{k} is the wavevector of the particle, r → r → vec(r)\vec{r} its position, and u ( k → , r → ) u ( k → , r → ) u( vec(k), vec(r))u(\vec{k}, \vec{r}) a space-dependent amplitude function which reflects the periodicity of the lattice:
其中 k → k → vec(k)\vec{k} 是粒子的波矢， r → r → vec(r)\vec{r} 是其位置， u ( k → , r → ) u ( k → , r → ) u( vec(k), vec(r))u(\vec{k}, \vec{r}) 是一个空间依赖的振幅函数，反映了晶格的周期性：
u ( k ⇀ , r ⇀ + R ⇀ ) = u ( k ⇀ , r ⇀ ) u ( k ⇀ , r ⇀ + R ⇀ ) = u ( k ⇀ , r ⇀ ) u(k^(⇀),r^(⇀)+R^(⇀))=u(k^(⇀),r^(⇀))u(\stackrel{\rightharpoonup}{k}, \stackrel{\rightharpoonup}{r}+\stackrel{\rightharpoonup}{R})=u(\stackrel{\rightharpoonup}{k}, \stackrel{\rightharpoonup}{r})
Fig. 4-2. One dimensional illustration of a Bloch wavefunction as a plane wave modulated by a periodic function which has the period of the lattice.
图 4-2. 一维布洛赫波函数的示意图，作为一个由具有晶格周期的周期函数调制的平面波。
Combining eq.(4.14) and eq.(4-15) leads us to
结合方程(4.14)和方程(4-15)我们得到
Ψ ( k ⇀ , r ⇀ + R ⇀ ) = exp ⁡ ( i k ⇀ ⋅ R ⇀ ) Ψ ( k ⇀ , r ⇀ ) Ψ ( k ⇀ , r ⇀ + R ⇀ ) = exp ⁡ ( i k ⇀ ⋅ R ⇀ ) Ψ ( k ⇀ , r ⇀ ) Psi(k^(⇀),r^(⇀)+R^(⇀))=exp(ik^(⇀)*R^(⇀))Psi(k^(⇀),r^(⇀))\Psi(\stackrel{\rightharpoonup}{k}, \stackrel{\rightharpoonup}{r}+\stackrel{\rightharpoonup}{R})=\exp (i \stackrel{\rightharpoonup}{k} \cdot \stackrel{\rightharpoonup}{R}) \Psi(\stackrel{\rightharpoonup}{k}, \stackrel{\rightharpoonup}{r})
for any lattice translation vector R → R → vec(R)\vec{R}.
对于任何晶格平移矢量 R → R → vec(R)\vec{R} 。
In one dimensional case, a a aa being the period of the potential or lattice, this can be written as:
在一维情况下， a a aa 为势能或晶格的周期，可以写成：
Ψ ( k , x + a ) = exp ⁡ ( i k a ) Ψ ( k , x ) Ψ ( k , x + a ) = exp ⁡ ( i k a ) Ψ ( k , x ) Psi(k,x+a)=exp(ika)Psi(k,x)\Psi(k, x+a)=\exp (i k a) \Psi(k, x)

问题：如何为晶体近似 V ( x ) V ( x ) V(x)V(x) ？

Assumption:  假设：
  • The lattice structure is considered to be perfect and the atoms to be fixed in position.
    晶格结构被认为是完美的，原子被固定在位置上。
  • Neglects any non-core electron-electron interaction which may occur in the crystal.
    忽略了晶体中可能发生的任何非核心电子-电子相互作用。
Fig. 4-3(a): Atomic cores with a net charge + Z + Z +Z+Z ’ q q qq and separated by a lattice constant a a aa are envisioned to extend from x = 0 x = 0 x=0\mathrm{x}=0 to x = ( N − 1 ) a x = ( N − 1 ) a x=(N-1)a\mathrm{x}=(\mathrm{N}-1) a. where N is the total number of atoms in the crystal.
图 4-3(a)：带有净电荷 + Z + Z +Z+Z ’ q q qq 的原子核，按晶格常数 a a aa 分开，预计从 x = 0 x = 0 x=0\mathrm{x}=0 延伸到 x = ( N − 1 ) a x = ( N − 1 ) a x=(N-1)a\mathrm{x}=(\mathrm{N}-1) a 。其中 N 是晶体中原子的总数。

4-2-2 克罗尼希-佩尼模型：

Fig. 4-4: Idealised periodic potential in which an array of rectangular potential wells and barriers having the lattice periodicity.
图 4-4：理想化的周期性势能，其中具有晶格周期性的矩形势阱和势垒阵列。
Each well represents an approximation of the potential produced by one ion.
每个势阱代表一个离子产生的势能的近似。
The Kronig-Penney Model analysis must be considered as classic required knowledge for anyone with a serious interest in devices since the analysis illustrates energy band concepts in a straightforward manner, with a minimum of math.
Kronig-Penney 模型分析必须被视为任何对设备有认真兴趣的人的经典必备知识，因为该分析以简单明了的方式阐明了能带概念，且数学要求最低。

4-2-3 Origin of the Energy Gap
4-2-3 能量间隙的起源

A rigorous treatment of the band theory of solids involves extensive quantum mechanical analysis and is beyond the scope of this course. However, we can attain a satisfactory understanding through a semi quantitative treatment.
对固体带理论的严格处理涉及广泛的量子力学分析，超出了本课程的范围。然而，我们可以通过半定量的处理获得令人满意的理解。
The gaps between the top of an allowed band and the bottom of the next one can be understood as a result of Bragg reflection of the travelling wave describing the electron propagating down the lattice (Fig. 4-7).
允许带的顶部与下一个带的底部之间的间隙可以理解为描述沿晶格传播的电子的行波的布拉格反射的结果（图 4-7）。
Fig. 4-7  图 4-7
Fig. 4-7 shows the electron is propagating in the forward direction along x x xx with a travelling function of the type ψ ( x ) = A e i k x ψ ( x ) = A e i k x psi(x)=Ae^(ikx)\psi(x)=A e^{i k x}. At each atom, some of this wave will be reflected. When the reflected wave A ′ , B ′ A ′ , B ′ A^('),B^(')\mathrm{A}^{\prime}, \mathrm{B}^{\prime} and C ′ C ′ C^(')\mathrm{C}^{\prime} will reinforce each other (if the path difference is n λ n λ n lambdan \lambda ), a full reflected wave would be created, travelling in backward direction:
图 4-7 显示电子沿 x x xx 向前传播，传播函数为 ψ ( x ) = A e i k x ψ ( x ) = A e i k x psi(x)=Ae^(ikx)\psi(x)=A e^{i k x} 类型。在每个原子处，这部分波会被反射。当反射波 A ′ , B ′ A ′ , B ′ A^('),B^(')\mathrm{A}^{\prime}, \mathrm{B}^{\prime} 和 C ′ C ′ C^(')\mathrm{C}^{\prime} 相互增强（如果路径差为 n λ n λ n lambdan \lambda ），将产生一个完全反射的波，向后传播：
2 a sin ⁡ θ = n λ 2 a sin ⁡ θ = n λ 2a sin theta=n lambda2 a \sin \theta=n \lambda,
Since θ = π 2 θ = π 2 theta=(pi)/(2)\theta=\frac{\pi}{2} and λ = 2 π k λ = 2 π k lambda=(2pi)/(k)\lambda=\frac{2 \pi}{k}, the Bragg condition becomes k = ± n π a k = ± n π a k=+-(n pi)/(a)k= \pm \frac{n \pi}{a}.
由于 θ = π 2 θ = π 2 theta=(pi)/(2)\theta=\frac{\pi}{2} 和 λ = 2 π k λ = 2 π k lambda=(2pi)/(k)\lambda=\frac{2 \pi}{k} ，布拉格条件变为 k = ± n π a k = ± n π a k=+-(n pi)/(a)k= \pm \frac{n \pi}{a} 。
Since the backward travelling wave ψ ( x ) = A e − i k x ψ ( x ) = A e − i k x psi(x)=Ae^(-ikx)\psi(x)=A e^{-i k x} will suffer reflection, the crystal will then contain waves travelling in the forward and backward directions.
由于向后传播的波 ψ ( x ) = A e − i k x ψ ( x ) = A e − i k x psi(x)=Ae^(-ikx)\psi(x)=A e^{-i k x} 会遭受反射，晶体将包含向前和向后传播的波。
It seems that the energy of the electron increases parabolically with k k kk along E k = ℏ 2 k 2 2 m E k = ℏ 2 k 2 2 m E_(k)=(ℏ^(2)k^(2))/(2m)E_{k}=\frac{\hbar^{2} k^{2}}{2 m} and then suddenly, at k = ± n π a k = ± n π a k=+-(n pi)/(a)k= \pm \frac{n \pi}{a}, it suffers a sharp discontinuity and increases parabolically again (see Fig. 4-6). Although the discontinuities at the critical points k = ± n π a k = ± n π a k=+-(n pi)/(a)k= \pm \frac{n \pi}{a} are expected, by virtue of Bragg reflection of waves, reflections effects will be present to a certain extent, even within a small region around k = ± n π a k = ± n π a k=+-(n pi)/(a)k= \pm \frac{n \pi}{a}. The individual reflections shown in Fig. 4-7 do not occur exactly at the origins of the atoms at x = a , 2 a , 3 a … x = a , 2 a , 3 a … x=a,2a,3a dotsx=a, 2 a, 3 a \ldots Rather, they occur over some distance, since the wave must interact with the electrons in the ion cores to be reflected. We therefore expect the E − k E − k E-kE-k behaviour (Fig. 4-6) to deviate from E k = ℏ 2 k 2 2 m E k = ℏ 2 k 2 2 m E_(k)=(ℏ^(2)k^(2))/(2m)E_{k}=\frac{\hbar^{2} k^{2}}{2 m} in the neighbourhood of the critical points, even if k k kk is not exactly n π a n π a (n pi)/(a)\frac{n \pi}{a}. The first reflections and the first energy gap occur at k = ± n π a k = ± n π a k=+-(n pi)/(a)k= \pm \frac{n \pi}{a}. The region in k k kk space between k = + π a k = + π a k=+(pi )/(a)k=+\frac{\pi}{a} and k = − π a k = − π a k=-(pi )/(a)k=-\frac{\pi}{a} is the first Brillouin zone of this lattice. Other energy gaps occur for other values of the integer n n nn (See Fig. 4-6).
电子的能量似乎沿着 E k = ℏ 2 k 2 2 m E k = ℏ 2 k 2 2 m E_(k)=(ℏ^(2)k^(2))/(2m)E_{k}=\frac{\hbar^{2} k^{2}}{2 m} 随着 k k kk 以抛物线方式增加，然后在 k = ± n π a k = ± n π a k=+-(n pi)/(a)k= \pm \frac{n \pi}{a} 时突然出现一个明显的不连续性，再次以抛物线方式增加（见图 4-6）。尽管在临界点 k = ± n π a k = ± n π a k=+-(n pi)/(a)k= \pm \frac{n \pi}{a} 处的不连续性是预期的，由于布拉格波的反射，反射效应在一定程度上会存在，即使在 k = ± n π a k = ± n π a k=+-(n pi)/(a)k= \pm \frac{n \pi}{a} 附近的小区域内也是如此。图 4-7 中显示的个别反射并不恰好发生在 x = a , 2 a , 3 a … x = a , 2 a , 3 a … x=a,2a,3a dotsx=a, 2 a, 3 a \ldots 的原子起点上，而是发生在一定距离之外，因为波必须与离子核中的电子相互作用才能被反射。因此，我们预计 E − k E − k E-kE-k 行为（图 4-6）在临界点附近会偏离 E k = ℏ 2 k 2 2 m E k = ℏ 2 k 2 2 m E_(k)=(ℏ^(2)k^(2))/(2m)E_{k}=\frac{\hbar^{2} k^{2}}{2 m} ，即使 k k kk 并不完全等于 n π a n π a (n pi)/(a)\frac{n \pi}{a} 。第一次反射和第一次能量间隙发生在 k = ± n π a k = ± n π a k=+-(n pi)/(a)k= \pm \frac{n \pi}{a} 。在 k k kk 空间中， k = + π a k = + π a k=+(pi )/(a)k=+\frac{\pi}{a} 和 k = − π a k = − π a k=-(pi )/(a)k=-\frac{\pi}{a} 之间的区域是该晶格的第一个布里渊区。其他能量间隙发生在整数 n n nn 的其他值上（见图 4-6）。
The wavefunctions at k = ± π a k = ± π a k=+-(pi )/(a)k= \pm \frac{\pi}{a} are not travelling wave e i π x a e i π x a e^(i pi(x)/(a))e^{i \pi \frac{x}{a}} or e − i π x a e − i π x a e^(-i pi(x)/(a))e^{-i \pi \frac{x}{a}} of free electrons. At these special values of k k kk the wavefunctions are made up of equal parts of waves travelling to the right and to the left. When the Bragg reflection condition k = ± n π a k = ± n π a k=+-(n pi)/(a)k= \pm \frac{n \pi}{a} is satisfied by the wavevector, a wave travelling to the right is Bragg-reflected to travel to the left, and vice versa. Each subsequent Bragg reflection will reverse the direction of travel of the wave. A wave travelling neither to the right nor left is a standing wave.
在 k = ± π a k = ± π a k=+-(pi )/(a)k= \pm \frac{\pi}{a} 处的波函数不是自由电子的行波 e i π x a e i π x a e^(i pi(x)/(a))e^{i \pi \frac{x}{a}} 或 e − i π x a e − i π x a e^(-i pi(x)/(a))e^{-i \pi \frac{x}{a}} 。在这些特殊的 k k kk 值下，波函数由向右和向左传播的波的相等部分组成。当波矢满足布拉格反射条件 k = ± n π a k = ± n π a k=+-(n pi)/(a)k= \pm \frac{n \pi}{a} 时，向右传播的波被布拉格反射以向左传播，反之亦然。每一次随后的布拉格反射都会反转波的传播方向。既不向右也不向左传播的波是驻波。

waves e a e a e^(a)e^{a} and e a e a e^(a)e^{a} (for simplicity we take n = 1 , k = π / a n = 1 , k = π / a n=1,k=pi//a\mathrm{n}=1, k=\pi / a ) :
波 e a e a e^(a)e^{a} 和 e a e a e^(a)e^{a} （为了简单起见，我们取 n = 1 , k = π / a n = 1 , k = π / a n=1,k=pi//a\mathrm{n}=1, k=\pi / a ）：

ρ ( − ) ρ ( − ) rho(-)\rho(-) differ by E g E g E_(g)E_{g}. Just below the energy gap at points B the wavefunction is ψ ( + ) ψ ( + ) psi(+)\psi(+), and just above the gap at point C C CC the wavefunction is ψ ( − ) ψ ( − ) psi(-)\psi(-). [Refer to Fig. 4.6]

Clearly, whenever k k kk has the critical values n π a n π a (n pi)/(a)\frac{n \pi}{a}, there are only two possible values for the energies E + E + E_(+)E_{+}and E − E − E_(-)E_{-}, as determined by eq.(4-25) and (4-26); no other energies are allowed in between.
